summary: ```markdown # Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2024.2 - GPU Simulation Optimization Hello everyone, in this video, we will introduce the GPU simulation optimization content of Marvelous Designer 2024.2. ## Improved GPU Simulation Conflict Processing In this update, the GPU simulation conflict processing has been greatly improved. This jacket is made up of a large number of panels, and the particle diameter of the panel is 5. When dragging the panel, there is no problem of layer intersection, and the simulation is stable and effective. ### Comparison with Previous Versions Compared to the 2024.2 version, the GPU simulation preset in Marvelous Designer 2024.2 is limited when dealing with conflicts between multiple layers of panels. You can see that there is a partial overlap between some panels. In the 2024.2 version, the simulation of this suit is more stable, and the simulation results are more reasonable. ## Simulation Menu Updates Now let's take a look at the update of the simulation menu. First of all, in the simulation type, the animation of the new animation used to record the cloth animation is completed. In addition, at the bottom of the simulation type, the option of changing between CPU and GPU simulation is added. ### Simulation Types Now, when choosing the various simulation types, you can choose to use the CPU or GPU to complete the simulation. The icon for the simulation preset is now empty-cast. In the previous version, the results of CPU simulation and GPU simulation were significantly different. From the 2024.2 version, we improved the accuracy of the GPU simulation to make it almost identical to the CPU simulation. ## Efficiency and Accuracy Now, through the updated GPU simulation, you can increase the efficiency of your work and achieve the same excellent simulation results. Next, let's compare the actual GPU simulation with the CPU simulation. If you look at the data statistics in the bottom left corner of the 3D window, you can see the relevant data of the version and the FPS rate. In the video, these versions have a peak value of more than 110,000. Let's choose the default settings to simulate first. ### Simulation Comparison On the left is the GPU simulation effect, and on the right is the CPU simulation effect. This video is not accelerated. You can see that although there is a huge difference in speed, the final simulation results are almost the same. ## Material Attribute Calculation Then, let's look at the simulation effect of the material attribute calculation type in Sichuan. The GPU simulation is also faster. This simulation setting will activate the precise material shrinkage simulation in the simulation attribute. In this way, you can get a more accurate simulation result, and the clothing will be more closely aligned with real-life effects. ### Animation Simulation Preset Finally, let's test the animation simulation preset. You can see that the GPU simulation is still much faster than the CPU simulation. The animation has completed the preset, allowing you to simulate a smoother and more stable cloth animation. ## Conflict Processing Function Now let's test the conflict processing function of the GPU simulation. Although it is now a three-layer version, the simulation can still be completed very smoothly. One of the advantages of using GPU simulation is that it can significantly improve work efficiency when processing low-chloride-resistant panels. ### Wind Simulation Effects Now, let's test the GPU simulation under the influence of the wind. Here, the video is not accelerated. You can see the actual simulation effect. Although there are many peak points in the grid, the wind-blow effect is still very fast. The GPU simulation is much faster than the CPU simulation, and the wind-blow effect is also quicker. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! The GPU simulation will also save you work time and improve efficiency. The video shows the real-time recording effect without acceleration. Because the speed of the GPU simulation will vary depending on the graphics card you use, in general, the GPU simulation has a significant improvement in speed compared to the CPU simulation. Please note that GPU simulation cannot be applied to close-up resolution and software model simulation for the time being. In the previous version, the simulation information was recorded in the project file, but from this version, the GPU simulation information will not be stored in the costume project file or the simulation attribute setting file. Please click the like button if you liked this video. Next, we'll take a look at the GPU simulation manager. Thank you for watching, and see you in the next video! ```
